title: Reverie module config
description: The values the host stores and hands over through the settings port. Every figure here is a starting value to tune against the eval corpus. Once packages/core/src/config exists it owns the shapes and the defaults, and this file mirrors it.

halfLifeDays.description: Half life of a memory's recency weight, by kind, counted from lastConfirmedAt. A procedure does not decay and has no entry. Nothing caches this, so a change applies on the next recall.

recall.description: What recall hands back. Below the floor nothing is returned and the result says sufficient: false.

coreTokenCap.description: Ceiling on the always-on core block. Pinning past it is refused until something is unpinned.

defaultShelf.description: Where a memory lands when no shelf is given: section code, a slash, shelf code. The seeded default is the Returns shelf at the front desk.

sessionNoteTtlHours.description: How long a session note lives before it expires unextracted.

staleAfterDays.description: Days since lastConfirmedAt after which a memory is listed as stale. Listing only: nothing is retired automatically.

autoAccept.description: Whether a drafted memory may be accepted without review after waiting unchallenged. Off by default. A procedure and a sensitive category never auto-accept, whatever this says.

embedding.description: The embedding model, when one is configured. Embedding rows are a cache of body and model, so a change re-embeds every memory before the new value counts as applied, and recall runs on full text search alone until that finishes.

consolidateEvery.description: When the host reports a consolidation as due. The host only says so: a model drafts it and a person confirms it.

incognito.description: The pause switch. While true no capture runs, no session is marked for extraction, and every write tool refuses with the reason; reads still answer.
